detail.longDescription: The danger of AI for me right now is that the more I use it, the more ambitious I’m getting with creating. It’s awesome! I’m cooking something I’m really excited about. It may not be exciting to many because we can all just make whatever we want pretty much. But I’m excited, and that’s all that matters. Stay tuned for a couple of OSS apps I’m creating to replace tools I use every day. #ai #create #apps #oss #opensource #dataliberation
